messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] technical details of mass matrix (Euclidean metric) estimation
parts:
Mitzi's starting to work on user-specified mass matrices, so it
shouldn't be long. It will need to filter through all the interfaces.

Just be careful---you can't just vary the mass matrix as you go
and get a proper Markov chain. RHMC uses an implicit integrator and
then has to adjust with a determinant.

- Bob
